Description: Infection of susceptible individuals through contact with infectious individuals in the community (I), hospitalized cases (H), or during funerals (F). Rate: (b_I*S*I + b_H*S*H + b_F*S*F)/N.
Progression of exposed individuals to become infectious. Rate: a*E.
Hospitalization of infectious individuals. Rate: c_h*h_1*I.
Death of infectious individuals in the community. Rate: d_1*(1-h_1)*c_d*I.
Death of hospitalized individuals. Rate: c_dh*d_2*H.

Name: N
Description: Size of the population.

Name: b_I
Description: Transmission coefficient in the community.

Name: b_H
Description: Transmission coefficient at the hospital.

Name: b_F
Description: Transmission coefficient during funerals.

Name: 1/a
Description: Mean duration of the incubation period.

Name: 1/c_h
Description: Mean duration from symptom onset to hospitalization.

Name: 1/c_d
Description: Mean duration from onset to death for patients who die.

Name: 1/c_i
Description: Mean duration from onset to end of infectiousness for survivors.

Name: 1/c_f
Description: Mean duration from death to traditional burial.

Name: h
Description: Proportion of cases hospitalized.

Name: d
Description: Overall case-fatality ratio.

Name: h_1
Description: Proportion of infectious cases that are hospitalized, computed to match the overall hospitalization proportion h.

Name: d_1
Description: Proportion of non-hospitalized cases that die, computed to match the overall case-fatality ratio d.

Name: d_2
Description: Proportion of hospitalized cases that die, computed to match the overall case-fatality ratio d.

Name: 1/c_dh
Description: Mean duration from hospitalization to death.

Name: 1/c_ih
Description: Mean duration from hospitalization to end of infectiousness for survivors.

Name: z
Description: Efficacy of interventions in the community, where the transmission coefficient is decreased by a factor (1-z).
